source.title: Next Week on XBOX: New Games for November 2 to 6
source.evidenceText: Will Fulton, XBOX Wire Editor October 30, 2026 · 10 min read Welcome to Next Week on XBOX! In this weekly feature we cover all the games coming soon to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass! Get more details on these upcoming games below and click their profiles for further info (release dates subject to change). Let’s jump in! ZERO PARADES: Director's Cut ZA/UM ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $39.99 $35.99 Get it now ZERO PARADES: Director’s Cut – November 3XBOX Play Anywhere From the creators of Disco Elysium comes ZERO PARADES – an espionage RPG. You’re a brilliant but tormented operant on one final desperate assignment. Gather your broken network, untangle a web of lies, and prove yourself on the world stage – or blow it all up again. GRAVHOUNDS (Game Preview) Octopus Panic, Inc ☆☆☆☆☆ 93 ★★★★★ $19.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Free Trial GRAVHOUNDS (Game Preview) – November 2Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere GRAVHOUNDS is a 1–4 player co-op action builder. Drop into hostile planets as a pack, build and defend your base in physics-driven mayhem, and extract with everything you can carry before you become alien chow! The longer you stay, the greater the danger… and the rewards. PIT OF GOBLIN Friendly Foe, Bright Gambit ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $7.99 $6.39 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass PIT OF GOBLIN – November 3Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Ever dreamt of being the lowest of the low, living a life so nasty and gnarly that even the rats look down on you? Well, in Pit of Goblin, that’s every day! Slap on your stinkiest boots and dive into crumbling crypts, ghastly caverns, and ghost-infested ruins. Every step is fraught with peril and surprise! Your purpose is feeding the King Queen’s bottomless gut. The best part? You can drag your goblin buddies along for the misery! VOID/BREAKER (Game Preview) Playstack ☆☆☆☆☆ 7 ★★★★★ Get it now PC Game Pass VOID/BREAKER (1.0) – November 4Game Pass You are trapped in an endless sequence by the all-seeing, hostile AI. You are its prisoner – forced to fight, die, and repeat. The machines think you’ll never escape. The system is designed to keep you here. This isn’t just shooting – it’s pure velocity. Run through relentless gunfights with fluid movement designed for high-paced action. Outmaneuver your enemies and dominate every firefight with agility and speed. Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School iam8bit Presents ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $19.99 Pre-order Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School – November 5Game Pass Class is (back) in session with Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School! Explore an all-new campus, escape life-threatening puzzle rooms, and unravel a conspiracy as old as the school itself — all before the bell rings. Play solo or grab a friend and start solving in online or local co-op. Football Manager 27 SEGA ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Football Manager 27 (PC Early Access) – November 3Game Pass Focus meets flow in FM27, delivering an evolved, easier to navigate experience, with new and returning features that invite discovery from the moment your save begins. Pre-orders on PC, Game Pass Ultimate, and PC Game Pass will grant early access starting on November 3. Bowling Alley Simulator Vulcron ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $14.99 Get it now Bowling Alley Simulator – November 3 Build, manage, and grow your very own bowling alley! Bowling Alley Simulator puts you in charge of every detail—from running the lanes to flipping burgers and keeping customers happy. Start small, make smart decisions, and turn your humble alley into a thriving entertainment hotspot. Kitties on Planets (Xbox Series) Afil Games ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $4.99 $3.99 Get it now Kitties on Planets – November 3 Get ready for a space adventure full of strategy in Kitties on Planets! Control two astronaut cats with different abilities and use their unique skills to place every supply box on its respective objective. Switch between the characters, combine their abilities, and discover the perfect solution for each puzzle! The End of the Sun The End of the Sun Forge ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now The End of the Sun – November 4 Become a tracker of mythical beings and supernatural forces. Wield the power of the fire of time, explore an ancient land, solve unusual riddles, and experience extraordinary adventures, all part of a greater, captivating story. Find your target, bring order to the chaos of time in the mysterious village, and uncover the secrets that lie within! The End of the Sun is a mystery-filled first-person adventure and exploration game set in a Slavic fantasy world. The core gameplay focuses on discovering an open world using a magical map and forming connections with bonfires. Each bond reveals new traces and events invisible to ordinary people. Fully kindled bonfires become gateways to time travel. Hidden Cats in Beijing Silesia Games Sp. z o.o. ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Hidden Cats in Beijing – November 4XBOX Play Anywhere Centuries ago, the ancestors of Beijing’s hidden cats traveled the legendary Silk Road to reach the Emperor’s palace. Now, they are hiding all over the city! Relax and enjoy a journey to the Far East and find +700 hidden cats in Beijing! Celebrate the Spring Festival by breathing new life into dragon dances and ancient legends, all set to the rhythm of traditional Chinese music. Honey Route (Xbox Series XS) Tribus Games Indie ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Honey Route – November 4 Honey Route is a relaxing path-connection puzzle set inside a beehive. Rotate the hexagonal honeycomb pieces to build continuous honey trails, guiding every worker bee to a queen. Start with a single bee and a single queen, and work your way up to huge hives where many bees and many queens share the same network. One bee can reach several queens, and several bees can reach the same queen. Kingdom of Night DANGEN Entertainment ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $19.99 $17.99 Pre-order Kingdom of Night – November 4 Kingdom of Night is an ‘80s-inspired isometric action RPG where coming-of-age drama meets cosmic horror. source.title: Modern Warfare 4 Season 1: Everything you need to know for November 6 launch
source.evidenceText: October 28, 2026October 28, 2026 Modern Warfare 4 Season 1: Everything you need to know for November 6 launch 7 0 33 Like this New Multiplayer maps and modes, a DMZ location, and more in the first free content update. Daniel Noel Writer, Activision Get ready for Season 1, with new maps, modes, events and rewards across Multiplayer and DMZ. Explore the unforgiving corridors of X01, wield new weapons and attachments, acquire new Operator Skins, Weapon Blueprints, DMZ Survival Kits, and more. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Season 1 goes live on November 6 Play Video New Multiplayer maps and modes Take the fight in Multiplayer across three new maps at Season 1 launch. Brave inclement weather across the all-new war torn Backstab, where abandoned tanks litter the landscape and drone ordinance line the shelves of a deserted dwelling. Battle amidst towering rock walls in the all-new Canyon and try your luck along the River near the Convoy Ambush or take the Cliff Path for its winding pathways. Drop into a reimagined Shoot House against the rugged terrain of North Korea during a snowfall. Also, at Season 1 launch, play the fan-favorite Grind mode where you eliminate players, recover their dog tags, and take them to the Bank to score for your team. Plus, Drop Zone mode returns where teams fight to hold a single rotating objective with periodic Killstreak packages airdrop over the Drop Zone. In the Mid-Season, we drop additional new maps and modes. Battle erupts at the all-new Ministry, causing damage to an embassy as you fight in and around the building on this diplomatic summit. Overflow is the new map centered around a factory and its surrounding farmland. Counter Attack is a new mode where your focus is detonating bombs at the enemy Comm Station while protecting your own from attack. DMZ’s new X01 weapon facility A formerly undiscovered weapons facility —codenamed X01 — has recently been seized by enemy forces. X01’s maze of tunnels and shifting hazards calls for careful planning, specialized equipment, and squad coordination. Expect new and powerful equipment and as the facility starts to close off extraction points, complete the required steps to escape, or else! In addition, expect multiple pages of new DMZ Orders inside X01 with plenty to uncover on deployment along, Threat Briefing to take down DMZ’s biggest Boss threats from Commanders and more, and Resupply Runs. New Warzone maps Play across two new maps in Call of Duty: Warzone as the Season 1 update brings both Hajin and Zodiac with additional game modes, gameplay features, and more. More intel to arrive soon, including full roadmap covering everything coming to Call of Duty: Warzone in Season 1. General content updates Expand your arsenal of weapons with the arrival of the Cronen Osprey Assault Rifle and the CSG-35 SMG in the Season 1 Battle Pass. The Cronen Osprey combines speed with moderate power for an Assault Rifle that’s quick and reliable on the frontlines. The CSG-35 SMG excels at putting down enemies fast at close ranges as it features the highest fire rate in its class The Season 1 Battle Pass is packed with 100+ pieces of unlockable content with an all-new catch-up system that guarantees 50+ rewards for those who purchase it. In addition to the normal unlocking of Battle Pass content, players who fall behind in the premium Battle Pass will be automatically caught up to the Reward matching the current day of the season, up to day 50. In addition, the Battle Pass itself is simpler to navigate, too: Log in to collect your rewards and keep playing to unlock a linear 100-tier track filled with additional Operator Skins, Weapon Blueprints, Finishing Moves, and more.
